verdict.rationale: three.js is a 3D library, and a natural-language interface (for example in its editor) is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only llms.txt/llms-full.txt docs that help external coding agents write three.js code, and records that no three.js MCP exists. That is an adjacent developer aid, not a product feature that accepts natural-language commands, so no credit is earned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
